name: Industrial Safety
description: PPE, work-zone, and equipment-safety investigation for factories, warehouses, and industrial sites.
demo_questions: Create a chronological safety summary and cite the relevant moments.
Which workers approach equipment, ladders, or restricted work zones?
Is there visible evidence of missing PPE or unsafe behavior?
search_prompts: person climbing or standing near a ladder
worker entering a restricted equipment zone

verification_rules.prompt: Across these time-ordered frames, is any person on the ladder without both a hardhat and a safety vest? Return only JSON. Set prediction_answer to YES or NO and reasoning to one concise evidence-based sentence.
verification_rules.system_prompt: You verify safety incidents from chronological camera frames. Return only one valid JSON object with keys prediction_answer and reasoning. prediction_answer must be exactly YES or NO.
